sloka: न नो दैवकृतं किञ्चिद्भयमस्ति कदाचन ।मानुषान्नो भयं राजंस्तुमुलं सम्प्रबाधते ।। ६.६०.७३ ।।।।
transliteration: na no daivakṛtaṁ kiñcidbhayamasti kadācana ।mānuṣānno bhayaṁ rājaṁstumulaṁ samprabādhate ।। 6.60.73 ।।।।

translations.english: This Lanka is seized by a mountain like army of Vanaras. By the abduction of Sita, there is little fear from Rama.
